name: karol-electron
author: Karol PDX
description: Karol Karaoke DJ — one Mac to rule them all

scripts.build: npm run install-api-deps && npx electron-builder --mac --dir && cp -R ../api-server/node_modules dist/mac-arm64/Karol.app/Contents/Resources/api-server/ && cp ../api-server/package.json dist/mac-arm64/Karol.app/Contents/Resources/api-server/ && /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Delete :ElectronAsarIntegrity' dist/mac-arm64/Karol.app/Contents/Info.plist 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.build:full: npm run install-api-deps && npx electron-builder --mac --dir && cp -R ../api-server/node_modules dist/mac-arm64/Karol.app/Contents/Resources/api-server/ && cp ../api-server/package.json dist/mac-arm64/Karol.app/Contents/Resources/api-server/ && /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Delete :ElectronAsarIntegrity' dist/mac-arm64/Karol.app/Contents/Info.plist 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.install-api-deps: cd /tmp && rm -rf karol-api-deps && mkdir karol-api-deps && cp /Users/macdonk/Documents/GitHub/Karol/api-server/package.json karol-api-deps/ && cd karol-api-deps && npm install --omit=dev --no-optional && cp -R node_modules /Users/macdonk/Documents/GitHub/Karol/api-server/

extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Karol needs access to your karaoke library on the external hard drive (/Volumes/maxone).
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Karol may read documents when importing media.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsUsageDescription: Karol may read Downloads when importing media.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Karol captures the Karol Phone Mirror window to show your phone on the HDMI karaoke display during Gap.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Karol may use camera devices for AV routing.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Karol may use audio input for phone mirror loopback.
